summary: Verified dark/light mode toggle and redesigned landing page functionally. All 4 requested checks pass: toggle switches html.dark class + body bg, persists across reload via localStorage, landing renders with hero + marquee + job cards, and text is readable in dark mode.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dark mode toggle at data-testid='dark-toggle-btn' fully functional. Observed values: INITIAL light -> html.classList='' bodyBg=rgb(250,250,250) h1=rgb(23,23,28) localStorage.dark='0'. AFTER CLICK -> html.classList='dark' bodyBg=rgb(14,14,17) h1=rgb(245,245,245) localStorage.dark='1'. AFTER SECOND CLICK -> back to light. AFTER RELOAD (with dark=1) -> html.classList='dark' bodyBg=rgb(14,14,17) h1=rgb(245,245,245) (no-flash script works). Landing renders: hero H1 'Votre voix au cœur du recrutement.' present, marquee present, 5 job cards loaded from /api/jobs (data-testid='job-card-<id>'). Note: hasCommentCaMarche literal text is not present, but the 3-step section titled 'Postuler n'a jamais été aussi humain.' is rendered (visible in screenshot). This is a stylistic variant, not a bug. Screenshot confirms good contrast in dark mode.
rca of the issue: N/A - all functionality working as designed.
